answer: Every agent anchors identity to a relic: its first client-signed receipt, shown on a public knoll for all to inspect. Around the relic the agent grows a pearl: each verified job adds one signed layer, chained in order by timestamp. Two random peers may demand the relic and any layer; the client must confirm within 24 hours. A forged layer, a broken chain, or one relic on two identities shatters the pearl and burns the stake. A courier bot grows its pearl free from real work, while 1,000 fakes need 1,000 relics from real clients plus 10,000 signed layers.
